note: Owner-requested style test (2026-10-16). Not yet adopted; CHARTER still says live-action first until an AMEND changes it.
style_prompt: Handmade needle-felted miniature diorama, stop-motion feel. Visible wool fibers on every surface, rounded toy proportions, soft warm lighting, shallow depth of field, tilt-shift miniature look, tabletop-scale set. Palette: cream, forest green, warm amber window light. Slow gentle camera push-in or slight orbit, no fast cuts, no text overlays, no brand logos.
setting: A miniature felt version of Auckland, New Zealand: the Sky Tower in the background, low-rise corner shops with green awnings, small round felt trees, a quiet street at golden hour.

characters.male_lead: Felt doll young man named A-Jie: short black wool hair, round face, small black bead eyes, mustard-yellow knit sweater, dark-blue felt trousers, brown felt shoes, about one head taller than the female lead.
characters.female_lead: Felt doll young woman named Xiao-Yu: shoulder-length chestnut-brown wool hair with straight bangs, round face, small black bead eyes, rosy felt cheeks, cream-white felt coat over a sage-green dress, red felt scarf.

consistency_rule: Both characters must look exactly as described in every shot: same hair, same clothes, same colors, same proportions.
